blocks.html: The details of the order payment collection to create or update.

types.name: CreateOrUpdateOrderPaymentCollectionInput
types.description: The details of the order payment collection to create or update.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The order to create or update payment collection for.

children.name: amount
children.description:
The amount to charge. It can't be greater than the
pending amount of the order. The order's payment collection
will be created or updated with this amount.
If no amount is set, the payment collection's amount is set to `0`.
